features_section.heading: Powerful Features for Communication & Gamers
features_section.description: Every feature we built is designed to give you the best digital communication experience ever.

cards.voice_chat_desc: High-definition audio with a smart engine that eliminates echo for a clear, delay-free chat experience.
cards.text_channels_desc: Organize chats in unlimited groups. Share images, GIFs, code, and stickers instantly with no subscription.
cards.screen_share_desc: Live stream games, movies or group workshops with friends in 4K 60F for free, smoothly.
cards.privacy_desc: Full encryption and maximum protection for your identity and private servers. Control admin and member permissions easily.
cards.cross_platform_desc: Move seamlessly between desktop, phone and browser anywhere in the world.

showcase_section.block_1_heading: Control Your Servers with Full Flexibility
showcase_section.block_1_desc: Give your friends proper permissions, divide servers into welcome, voice, or specialized discussion rooms. Add interactive bots and live effects.
showcase_section.block_2_heading: Dedicated Rooms for Streaming & Video Chat
showcase_section.block_2_desc: Connect with your team face-to-face with amazing quality. Foxy connects peers directly over WebRTC, with automatic STUN/TURN fallback so calls survive strict NATs.

cta_section.heading: Get Ready to Elevate Your Social Experience
cta_section.description: Join thousands of users who trust Foxy for communication, daily fun, and gaming. Free, vibrant, and essential.

landing.meta_desc: Foxy — high-quality voice rooms, low latency, vibrant communities. Join a room and try free from your browser.
landing.hero_sub: Foxy servers with voice and text rooms. Pick a community below and join straight from your browser.
landing.hero_note: Biggest server on Foxy — live data from the database
landing.live_sub: Registered Foxy servers with real data: members and channels. The red badge means someone is talking in a voice room now.
landing.feat_sub: Voice & text rooms and servers — try it from your browser.
landing.feat1_d: Live voice between members, mute/unmute and screen share. Real ping shown above, measured from your device.
landing.feat2_d: Every voice room has its own chat — images, stickers and replies, no mess.
landing.feat3_d: Share your game or tutorial with the room in one click, from browser or mobile.
landing.feat4_d: Mute, kick, roles and private rooms. Control panel for moderators.
landing.feat5_d: Browser, Android, iOS and PC. Join from anywhere and continue where you left off.
landing.feat6_d: Welcome bot, points and daily competitions to keep the room alive.
landing.step1_d: Browse servers above and join what you like — or create your own free.
landing.step2_d: Straight from the browser, no download. Sign up in 10 seconds if you want.
landing.step3_d: You'll hear people instantly. Make your own room and invite friends with a link.
landing.show1_d: Welcome, voice and discussion rooms. Clear permissions and helpful bots.
landing.show2_t: Voice & video rooms from the app
landing.show2_d: Join from the login page and see real rooms and channels — same data shown above.
landing.cta_title: Ready to join your first community?
landing.cta_sub: Totally free. Join from your browser now — or create your own server and invite friends.
landing.foot_desc: Voice rooms platform. Clear voice, live communities, instant browser join.
